profile.name: 文件通信接口
profile.description: 用于通过文件、字符设备文件或类 Unix 套接字进行读写通信的软件接口。它常用于把实验仪器暴露为可读写文件节点的场景，以便发送原始字节、读取返回数据并管理基本文件位置与结束符设置。
profile.description_en: A software communication interface for reading from and writing to files, character device nodes, or Unix-like sockets. It is commonly used when a laboratory instrument is exposed as a readable/writable file endpoint, allowing raw byte exchange and basic management of file position and line termination.

registry.name: File Communicator
registry.description: File Communicator驱动，支持address/close/flush input/read raw/seek等9个操作。
